critical_code_review_comments: Two frontend trees exist in repo: /app/src (actual compiled source, used by build) and /app/frontend/src (older legacy copy that lacks support-inbox / LiveNowBanner changes). The review request's files_of_reference use /app/src/... which is correct. The /app/frontend/src tree is stale and risks confusing future agents — recommend removing or clearly marking it as legacy.
server.py is 6111 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting support-bot / admin-support endpoints into their own module like live_alerts.py.

rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found. One initial test failure was in the test itself: the first version assumed unread would decrease by exactly 1 after opening a thread, but support_thread marks *all* of that user's inbound messages as read, so the drop can be >1. Fixed assertion to < unread_before.
